name: r10-g-e2-g2-coop
author: solx-loop
description: At 8,320 and 4,96, K3 plus the cuBLASLt GEMM2 (20.2 / 12.2 us rented) are replaced by one cooperative tcgen05 launch, g_g2, so these rows run 3 launches instead of 4. Phase P computes s_b and writes A_b = fp16(W2*s_b) with K3's arithmetic, and the image-0 CTAs write b2' in fp32. The h B-stages are TMA-prefetched before one flat self-resetting grid barrier.
